description: HC-1: drives a Haken Eagan Matrix instrument over MIDI — its preset list, its favourites, and knobs and CV for the macros, the recirculator and the output level

params.text: Sets that macro on the device; the panel shows the name the preset gives it, or a Roman numeral where the preset names none
Sets that recirculator parameter; the panel label changes with the recirculator the preset uses
Silences the device while it is on
Switches the knob beside it between absolute and relative control voltage: absolute makes a patched cable set the value on its own, relative adds the cable to the knob
Turns the recirculator's extended half-sample-rate computation on and off; the setting returns to the preset's own when you reload the preset
Turns the recirculator on and off; this setting is global and does not change with the preset

inputs.text: Sets that macro from a cable, 0V to 10V on its own or added to the knob when its relative button is on
Sets that recirculator parameter from a cable, 0V to 10V on its own or added to the knob when its relative button is on; this is the R1 jack, despite the maker's tooltip reading R2
Sets the recirculator mix from a cable, 0V to 10V on its own or added to the knob when its relative button is on
Sets the post level from a cable, 0V to 10V on its own or added to the knob when its relative button is on
Mutes the device on a trigger

outputs.text: A trigger once the device has finished initialising and is ready to play

notes: this module takes a minute or two the first time it runs, while it finds the device, opens the MIDI ports and reads every preset; the row of dots along the bottom is blue once it is ready
CV inputs are read only once the device has reached that ready state
the preset list, the tabs, the heart and the paging buttons are drawn by the module rather than built from knobs, so no click on them reaches this help
switching the recirculator to Analog Echo with the feedback or the mix high can produce damagingly loud output
the maker wrote this for Eagan Matrix firmware 10.09, and says some features do not work on later firmware
menu: Restore last preset at startup — selects the preset this module last had, instead of leaving the device on whatever preset it is showing
Use saved system presets — starts from the stored list of system presets instead of reading them back from the device
Use saved user presets — starts from the stored list of user presets instead of reading them back from the device
Refresh current preset — requests the settings of the preset the device is on
Refresh User presets — reads the list of user presets back from the device
Refresh System presets — reads the list of system presets back from the device
Center knobs — puts every knob at its middle position
Center Macro knobs — puts the six macro knobs at their middle position
Zero knobs — puts every knob except the volume at zero
Absolute CV — puts every control into absolute mode
Relative CV — puts every control into relative mode
Recirculator: Reverb, Mod delay, Swept Echo, Analog Echo, Delay LPF, Delay HPF — changes the recirculator the device is using until the preset is reloaded
Reboot HC-1 — starts the whole connection over and re-reads every user and system preset from the device
Send one handshake (ping) — pings the device once, which takes a fresh reading of its DSP usage
Remake QSPI data — rebuilds the device's additive data, as the Haken Editor does
